newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Two senior Philippine generals hurt in crash.
newsitem.headline: Two senior Philippine generals hurt in crash.

text.p: Two senior generals were injured when an army helicopter carrying nine people crash-landed on Thursday in the southern Philippines, the military said.

Victor Garcia, chief of the armed forces civil-military office, and intelligence chief Benjamin Libarnes received minor injuries when their helicopter had engine trouble and landed on its side in a muddy field on the outskirts of Zamboanga city, a military report said.
The party was on an inspection trip in the southern islands, where government forces are fighting Moslem separatist rebels.
